parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for CHEMBL1865 (HDAC6) where compounds have a canonical SMILES and the source document has a PubMed ID. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, and docs via the provenance path molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Inner join compound_structures to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
